policies.title: EU, EEA, Swiss and French ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current France-Visas guidance expressly exempts EU, EEA and Swiss nationals from overseas-territory visas. FR is represented as visa_free rather than citizenship because the destinations are territorial catalog codes PF and NC.
conditions: Ordinary passport held as a citizen of the listed EU, EEA or Swiss state; up to 90 days.
This records only the short visitor visa result, not residence, employment, family-member residence cards, identity-document alternatives, transit, special passports or final admission.
French Polynesia and New Caledonia are outside Schengen and remain separately scoped destinations.

policies.title: Named Annex II ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current French Polynesia and New Caledonia Annex II schedules expressly exempt these passport nationalities without a biometric, residence, visa, cruise, work or special-document qualifier.
conditions: For a short visitor stay of up to three months in each six-month period.
GB records the ordinary United Kingdom baseline; separate named British non-British-Citizen document statuses are not mapped to the catalog.
The schedules separately mention New Zealand passport holders from Cook Islands, Niue and Tokelau; that document condition is not mapped to CK or NU catalog codes.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visitor visa-free treatment with work exception
policies.summary: The current schedules expressly waive visas for ordinary visitor travel by these nationalities, with a narrow listed exception for certain paid activities lacking the required work authorisation.
conditions: Short tourism or other non-remunerated visitor entry up to three months per six-month period.
Excludes the schedule's paid-activity/work-authorisation exception, residence, transit, diplomatic, service and special-document routes.
The U.S. extension for American Samoa and Guam applies only when the traveler holds a U.S. passport; it is not mapped to AS or GU catalog codes.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Both current schedules separately name the Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passport documents; they do not grant the same rule to a PRC ordinary passport.
conditions: Only a Hong Kong SAR or Macao SAR passport respectively; up to three months in each six-month period.
Excludes PRC passport, Taiwan identity-number, residence-permit, cruise, transit, work, diplomatic, service and special-document routes.

policies.title: Other ordinary passports: territory-specific advance visa required
policies.summary: For the remaining catalog ordinary passports, the two current orders require a valid territory-specific visa unless the traveler qualifies for a separately specified exemption. The required visa is a physical vignette, so it is normalized as advance visa rather than eVisa.
conditions: Short visitor baseline only. A Schengen visa alone is insufficient; the visa must be valid for the requested overseas territory.

Residence permits, long-stay visas, French multi-entry visas, cruise conditions, transit, diplomatic, service, official and other special-document exemptions remain conditional and are not normalized as nationality-wide visitor access.

For Vanuatu, the listed ordinary-passport waiver is limited to passports issued before 25 May 2015; the current entry order also requires a travel document issued less than ten years earlier, so it cannot support a current ordinary-passport waiver.
No eVisa or ETA is inferred from France-Visas' online application workflow.

conflicts.explanation: The current New Caledonia order exempts only free-movement beneficiaries and Annex II entries; the 28 May 2025 order removed Georgia's Annex II line effective after publication.
